about_the_game:
Fight Infinity spawning waves of zombies on handcrafted maps as you try to survive until time is up. Based on your difficulty, rounds can range from 5 minutes to 30 minutes, with you being able to endlessly play once finished.

As you fight, watch out for the weapons spawn Pedi stools, which can spawn a weapon box of 4 rarity's (common, rare, epic, and legend). But be careful, as you use a weapon, its durability will decrease, making it so you constantly have to cycle through different weapons. You will also have to keep collecting ammo boxes from killed zombies to replenish your supply.

Every 5 minutes you will have to fight a boss so then you can continue. Once the last boss of the round has been defeated, the teleporter back to the Hanger will open up. You have to keep fighting waves of Zombies as the teleporter prepares to extract, then your home free to escape.

Features

  • 9 Unique Maps to fight on

  • Dozens of types of zombies

  • Earn Evolution Points to unlock new perks to enhance future rounds

  • 100 Unique guns to find and use

  • 6 Different difficulty levels with modifiers

Fight Waves of Zombies

  • Infinite Zombies spawn

  • Over 20 different Zombie Types with unique movement and attacks

  • Fight Bosses to open the Portal to win

Collect Unique Weapons

  • 100 Unique Weapons

  • 4 different weapon rarity's

  • Collect weapons by finding Weapon Boxes around the levels

  • Chance to Apply Weapon mods

name: Day of the Undead
short_description: Fight endless waves of zombies across 9 unique maps! Collect powerful, unique guns, unlock game-changing perks, and survive as long as you can in this fast-paced arcade shooter. How long can you last against the undead?
